overview.title: What is Viva City?
overview.text: Viva City is a community building a permanent longevity city in a special regulatory zone, where residents govern to accelerate medical innovation.

overview.title: Who joins Viva City?
overview.text: Viva City draws entrepreneurs, scientists, biohackers, and builders focused on health extension and longevity research. Pop-up events at Frontier Tower in San Francisco have attracted founders and researchers working across longevity biotech, AI, and cryptocurrency. Past participants include Vitalik Buterin, Peter Diamandis, Joe Lonsdale, Bryan Johnson, Naval Ravikant, Jaan Tallinn, and Aubrey de Grey.

history.text:
Viva City traces its roots to the pop-up city movement that began with Zuzalu, a 2023 two-month experiment in Montenegro convened by Vitalik Buterin. Laurence Ion co-organized Vitalia, the next major longevity pop-up, which ran inside the Prospera special economic zone on Roatan island in Honduras and drew hundreds of longevity researchers, investors, and entrepreneurs.

In January 2025, Ion and Vitalia co-founder Niklas Anzinger announced they were each pursuing separate ventures. Ion launched Viva City with a mission to build a city within a special regulatory zone governed by its residents, to accelerate medical innovation and extend healthy lifespan. Anzinger pursued a different path through Infinita City.

Since its founding, Viva City has organized Viva Frontier Tower in San Francisco, running annually as a 6-week vertical village at 995 Market Street. Parallel pop-ups have included Bloom City in Los Angeles (summer 2025) and an affiliated Berlin hub called Zelar (late 2024). The team continues negotiations with governments to secure a permanent territory for the long-term city.

location:
Viva City operates primarily from the United States, with its flagship hub at [Frontier Tower](https://viva.city/frontier-tower) at 995 Market Street in San Francisco, a 16-story building in the Mid-Market district. Floor 11 serves as the dedicated Longevity Floor, housing co-working space, a longevity clinic, and a startup incubator, while the 16th-floor lounge hosts daily events and rooftop gatherings.

Viva City has also run events in Los Angeles (Bloom City, 2025) and lists an affiliated Berlin hub called Zelar (late 2024). All current programming takes place in the United States while the team negotiates a permanent special regulatory zone with governments. A $2M finder's fee is offered to anyone who facilitates contact with a state willing to grant territory for the permanent city.
duration:
Viva City events run in 2-week to 6-week formats. The flagship Viva Frontier Tower program runs for 6 weeks each summer (June through early August), with individual 2-week tracks covering longevity, AI, crypto, robotics, and arts.

Participants can join for a specific 2-week track or attend the full 6-week program. A startup incubator runs concurrently throughout and concludes with a Demo Day near the end of the program. The broader Viva City community operates year-round online and through periodic in-person gatherings.
pricing:
The Viva Frontier Tower 2026 (June 20 - August 4, San Francisco) is priced at $950 per person. Tower citizens receive a $200 discount on the 2-week longevity track (bringing the price to $750), and a $300 or more discount on full-program access.

Scholarships covering partial or full costs are available for students, early-stage startup founders, open-source contributors, academic researchers in longevity, AI, or crypto, and event volunteers. Apply via [lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower](https://lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower) and indicate your circumstances.

howToEnter.text:
Applications for Viva Frontier Tower 2026 (June 20 - August 4 in San Francisco) are open. Apply via [lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower](https://lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower). Scholarships are available for students, early-stage founders, open-source contributors, academic researchers in longevity, AI, or crypto, and event volunteers.

To join the broader Viva City community, submit a join form on [viva.city](https://viva.city). Government representatives interested in discussing regulatory sandbox opportunities can contact the team directly through the site.

faqs.question: What is Viva City?
faqs.answer: Viva City is a community and project building toward a permanent city in a special regulatory zone, governed by residents, to accelerate medical innovation and extend healthy lifespan. While the permanent city location is still being negotiated, the project runs pop-up events and urban hubs - most prominently Viva Frontier Tower in San Francisco.

faqs.question: Who founded Viva City?
faqs.answer: Viva City was founded by Laurence Ion, a longevity investor and entrepreneur who previously co-created VitaDAO and co-organized Vitalia (a longevity pop-up city in Prospera, Honduras). Ion launched Viva City in January 2025 following a [joint announcement](https://news.viva.city/p/joint-statement-of-vitalia-co-founders) that he and Vitalia co-founder Niklas Anzinger were each pursuing separate projects.

faqs.question: How does Viva City relate to Vitalia and Zuzalu?
faqs.answer: Zuzalu was a 2023 pop-up city in Montenegro organized by Vitalik Buterin, which popularized the co-living experiment format for the longevity and crypto communities. Vitalia grew out of Zuzalu and ran as a longevity pop-up inside the Prospera special economic zone in Honduras. Laurence Ion co-organized Vitalia before founding Viva City as a larger, longer-term project in early 2025.

faqs.question: What is the Viva Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: The Viva Frontier Tower is a 6-week vertical village held each summer at Frontier Tower (995 Market Street, San Francisco), a 16-story building. The program combines co-working, events, workshops, and hackathons across longevity, AI, crypto, robotics, and arts tracks. Past speakers have included Jean Hebert (ARPA-H), Joe Lonsdale (Palantir), Vitalik Buterin, Peter Diamandis (XPRIZE), and Jaan Tallinn (Skype). The 2026 edition runs June 20 - August 4.

faqs.question: When and where does the 2026 Viva Frontier Tower event run?
faqs.answer: The 2026 Viva Frontier Tower runs June 20 - August 4, 2026, at 995 Market Street in San Francisco. Individual 2-week tracks start on specific dates within that window. [Apply or register at lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower](https://lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower).

faqs.question: What does a Viva Frontier Tower ticket include?
faqs.answer: Tickets include access to all speaker sessions and workshops, daily healthy weekday lunches, community events and rooftop gatherings, free biological age and health tests, co-working spaces, and community channels. Genomic testing is included in limited quantity. The startup incubator track runs throughout the program and concludes with a Demo Day.

faqs.question: Are scholarships available for Viva Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Yes. Viva City offers scholarships to students, early-stage startup founders, open-source contributors, academic researchers in longevity, AI, or crypto, and event volunteers. Apply through the main registration form at [lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower](https://lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower) and indicate your circumstances in the application.

faqs.question: What is a Tower citizen and how do I qualify for the discount?
faqs.answer: Tower citizens are longer-term residents or established members of Frontier Tower. They receive a $200 discount on the 2-week longevity track (from $950 to $750) or $300 or more off full-program access. Check the registration page at [lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower](https://lu.ma/viva-frontier-tower) for current eligibility details.

faqs.question: What program tracks are offered at Viva Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: The 2026 program includes tracks on Longevity, AI, Crypto, Robotics and Deep Tech, Neurotech and Biotech Lab, Human Flourishing, and Arts and Music. A startup incubator runs concurrently throughout all 6 weeks and culminates in a Demo Day on August 1, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the $2M location finder's fee?
faqs.answer: Viva City is seeking a government or territory willing to host its permanent special regulatory zone. Laurence Ion has offered a $2M finder's fee to anyone who facilitates a productive contact with the leadership of a state that agrees to lend territory for this purpose. Details are on the [Viva City website](https://viva.city/).

faqs.question: What is Viva City's long-term mission?
faqs.answer: Viva City's stated mission is to establish a permanent city in a special regulatory zone governed by its residents, with a focus on longevity, AI, and medical innovation. The project describes itself as an 'Apollo Project for longevity' aimed at making death optional by 2040. The permanent city location is still under negotiation with governments.

faqs.question: What past events has Viva City organized?
faqs.answer: Viva City organized Viva Frontier Tower I (June 20 - August 4, 2025) in San Francisco with 350+ participants across longevity, AI, and crypto tracks. A parallel pop-up, Bloom City, ran in Los Angeles from June 22 - August 16, 2025. An affiliated Berlin hub, Zelar, ran in late 2024. The 2026 Viva Frontier Tower edition runs June 20 - August 4, 2026.
